CustomField.description: IM-232:This will inform the end year for an initiative based on its record type. For Budgeted Initiative, End year is taken form End Date in IM where as for Misc Initiatives it will come from Bgive. IM-259: Field has been converted to Text from Number due to incorrect rendering on List Views.
CustomField.formula: IF((RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Budgeted_Initiative' || RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Amendment'), TEXT(YEAR( End_Date__c )) , IF( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Non_Budgeted_Initiative', Latest_Payment_Year__c, '' ))
CustomField.label: End Year
